newsitem.title: POLAND: Polifarbs, merger seen by Oct.
newsitem.headline: Polifarbs, merger seen by Oct.

text.p: The planned merger of Polish paintmakers Polifarb Cieszyn SA and Polifarb Wroclaw SA is likely to be concluded by the end of September, Cieszyn's president said on Friday.

"The (decisions) of both Polifarbs concerning the merger are valid until the end of September, that's why the whole merger has to be concluded by that time," Andrzej Jurkiewicz told Reuters, after Wroclaw's extraordinary shareholders meeting.

Wroclaw's shareholders decided on Friday to abandon plans of a bonus share issue, before the merger, paving the way for its consclusion, likely in favour for Cieszyn's shareholders, giving them 53.5 percent in the merged firm.
The merger was approved by shareholders of both firms in late March.
